QpTopicReplicate.description:
One reference-only replicate's item-level measurement (``docs/qp-topic.md``).

A replicate labels the frame's reference block alone and publishes nothing:
it exists to measure how far one labeler's agreement moves between runs on
identical inputs. The pooled figures sit on the run record beside this; what
this adds is what separates a run-level component from item-level noise —
which reference rows this run matched, as one character per reference entry
in ``case_id`` order — and the shares the gate candidates are cut by. The
reference entries are committed already, so the string discloses nothing a
reader of the reference file does not hold. ``reference_sha256`` pins which
reference the string indexes and ``prompt_sha256`` which labeling prompt was
read: replicates that differ on either are not pooled, since a reference
revision or a prompt edit would land in the run-level component.

matches.description: One character per reference entry in case_id order: 1 the labeler matched the reference label, 0 it did not, - the entry was not in the replicate's extract
matches.title: Matches

per_input_kind.description: Agreement per application input kind; empty on the petition frame, whose reference rows are all questions-presented text
per_input_kind.title: Per Input Kind

prompt_sha256.description: sha256 of the labeling prompt the replicate's labeler read; replicates under different prompts are not pooled
prompt_sha256.title: Prompt Sha256

reference_sha256.description: sha256 of the committed reference file the replicate was measured against
reference_sha256.title: Reference Sha256

unclassifiable.description: Compared reference entries the labeler labeled `unclassifiable`
unclassifiable.title: Unclassifiable

description:
``data/qp-topics/spend/<run_id>-<run_attempt>.json`` — one labeling run's spend.

One record per attempt of the labeling job whose engine left an execution
file, whatever became of the batch: a run refused at the reference gate
spends as much as one that publishes and writes no labels file, so the
spend lives here rather than on the labels artifact's batch ledger. The
token counts are the engine log's, read and priced by the rule every
cell's ``usage.json`` is (:func:`fedcourtsai.usage.parse_claude_usage`,
:func:`fedcourtsai.pricing.estimate_cost_usd`), so a labeler dollar and a
cell dollar are the same dollar, and the measured spend total
(:func:`fedcourtsai.spend.measured_spend`) sums these by ``recorded_at``.

The gate figures are carried for the same reason: a refused attempt is on
file with its measured agreement, and the label seam's review hold reads
the newest gated outcome per frame (:mod:`fedcourtsai.review_hold`).

agree.description: Compared reference entries matched; null unmeasured
agree.title: Agree

batch_rows.description: Rows in the extract the labeler was handed
batch_rows.title: Batch Rows

estimated_cost_usd.description: The run's on-demand cost at `pricing.MODEL_RATES` for `model`, or for `priced_as` where `model` has no rate
estimated_cost_usd.title: Estimated Cost Usd

floor.description: What a constant labeler scores on the same compared entries; null when unmeasured
floor.title: Floor

frame.description: Which labeling frame the run labeled: a topic-label frame, or `alignment-sides` for the merits side coder, which has no reference gate
frame.title: Frame

label_lines.description: Label lines the run left behind
label_lines.title: Label Lines

lane.description: The spend lane this run belongs to
lane.title: Lane

model.description: The model the cost rates were applied to
model.title: Model

outcome.description: published: the batch cleared the reference gate (a side-coding run: coded every row) and its labels were handed to the publish job; refused: it was measured and fell below the gate; incomplete: it reached neither (a labels file short of the batch, a check ahead of the measurement that failed, or a measurement that cleared the gate but did not reach publication), its gate figures carried wherever it was measured; replicate: a reference-only replicate that labeled the reference block alone, measured it, and published nothing by design, so it is neither a pass nor a refusal
outcome.title: Outcome

priced_as.description: The `pricing.MODEL_RATES` entry the run was priced at when `model` has none: the one that prices these token counts dearest, so an unpriced model's spend is still counted and never under-counted; null when priced at `model`'s own rate
priced_as.title: Priced As

rate.description: agree / n — agreement with the frame's reference, not accuracy; null when unmeasured or nothing was compared
rate.title: Rate

recorded_at.description: When the record was written, timezone-aware; the spend window reads it
recorded_at.title: Recorded At

replicate.description: A replicate run's item-level measurement; present exactly when the outcome is `replicate`

run_id.description: The Actions run id of the labeling run
run_id.title: Run Id
